'''Vedder''' was an [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[Major/Legends|major]] stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rhamalai]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. When [[General/Legends|General]] [[Naem Yrros|Yrros]] noticed that [[Denel Moonrunner]] looked familiar, and determined that his father was a former Imperial major named [[Lorn Moonrunner|Corvus Langlier]], he told Vedder to have Denel brought to his office. Vedder responded that Denel was on assignment, however, and since Denel was still a conscript, Yrros said he could not be allowed to leave the base, and had to be located immediately.
